title: The Drowned Abbey
blurb: An abbey on the sandflats goes under, and the news travels east faster than the water does.

beats.journal: Ilse says the abbey bell has not rung for two days, and will not cross to a silent abbey. Go east to Ash Hollow and ask Rell Ashcombe.
Rell has seen the water over the spit three times and it has not gone back. The abbey is under.
